self|dnd_one_shot_request: The user requested a D&D one-shot adventure designed for level 8 player characters.
self|dnd_one_shot_requested_elements: The one-shot should include enemy stat blocks, loot if the party succeeds, a surprise twist in the final battle, cool lair actions, and detailed trap and GM-running guidance.
assistant|dnd_adventure_title: The assistant titled the one-shot adventure "The Lost Temple of the Djinn."
assistant|dnd_adventure_premise: A powerful Djinn named Zoltar once ruled a vast temple of treasures and magical artifacts justly, then disappeared, leaving the temple lost to time.
assistant|dnd_adventure_hook: A wealthy collector hired the party to retrieve an artifact from the lost temple; the collector located the temple but lacks the power to retrieve it himself.
assistant|dnd_adventure_challenges: The party must navigate traps and puzzles to reach the artifact, facing mummies, undead warriors, and constructs guarding the temple's treasures.
assistant|dnd_enemy_mummy_count: The one-shot features 4 mummies as enemies.
assistant|dnd_enemy_mummy_speed: The mummies have a speed of 20 ft.
assistant|dnd_enemy_mummy_immunities: The mummies are immune to poison and psychic damage and to the charmed, exhausted, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions.
assistant|dnd_enemy_mummy_curse_of_the_p: The mummies' Curse of the Pharaohs forces a DC 15 Wisdom save on touch or melee hit within 5 ft.; a cursed target can't regain hit points and its hit point maximum is reduced by 10 (3d6) for 24 hours, until removed by remove curse or similar magic.
assistant|dnd_enemy_mummy_rot: The mummies' Slam attack inflicts Mummy Rot on a failed DC 15 Constitution save, with effects per Monster Manual appendix A.
assistant|dnd_enemy_construct_guardian_c: The one-shot features 2 construct guardians as enemies.
assistant|dnd_enemy_construct_guardian_a: The construct guardians have Armor Class 17 (natural armor).
assistant|dnd_enemy_construct_guardian_h: The construct guardians have 110 hit points (13d10 + 30).
assistant|dnd_enemy_construct_guardian_s: The construct guardians have a speed of 30 ft.
assistant|dnd_enemy_construct_guardian_i: The construct guardians are immune to poison and psychic damage and to the charmed, exhausted, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions.
assistant|dnd_enemy_construct_guardian_t: The construct guardians have Immutable Form (immune to form-altering effects), Magic Resistance (advantage on saves vs. spells and magical effects), Magic Weapons (weapon attacks are magical), and Siege Monster (double damage to objects and structures).
assistant|dnd_enemy_skeletal_warrior_cou: The one-shot features 6 skeletal warriors as enemies.
assistant|dnd_enemy_skeletal_warrior_arm: The skeletal warriors have Armor Class 12.
assistant|dnd_enemy_skeletal_warrior_hit: The skeletal warriors have 22 hit points (5d8).
assistant|dnd_enemy_skeletal_warrior_spe: The skeletal warriors have a speed of 30 ft.
assistant|dnd_enemy_skeletal_warrior_imm: The skeletal warriors are immune to poison and psychic damage and to the charmed, exhausted, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions.
assistant|dnd_enemy_skeletal_warrior_und: The skeletal warriors' Undead Fortitude lets them drop to 1 hit point instead of 0 on a successful Constitution save of DC 5 + damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit.
assistant|dnd_trap_pressure_plate_puzzle: The pressure plate puzzle room has floor plates where the wrong plate triggers a poison dart trap; an Intelligence (Investigation) check DC 15 reveals which plates are safe.
assistant|dnd_trap_spinning_blade_trap: The spinning blade trap fills a hallway with blades activated by a pressure plate; a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check DC 15 is required, though the assistant's description was cut off mid-sentence.
self|session_date: The session took place on 2023/05/21 (Sunday) at 13:00.
